title: atla.in sites · Overview
description: Status, uptime, speed, traffic and server errors for every atla.in site.

options.content: One line per site. Open a site's own dashboard for detail. Every figure is measured; "No check" means that site's uptime check is not set up yet.

panels.title: Status now
panels.description: Whether the latest run of the uptime check succeeded from every probe. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "atla.in homepage".

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Share of check runs that succeeded over the selected range, across all probes. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "atla.in homepage".

panels.title: Check duration
panels.description: Average time for one check run (DNS, connect, TLS, response) over the selected range. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "atla.in homepage".

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests CloudFront served for atla.in in the selected range. Includes bots. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution E2OMRFTQ27WGMZ.

panels.title: 5xx rate
panels.description: Request-weighted 5xx rate for atla.in. Weighted by requests: per minute, errors = rate × requests; the panel shows total errors ÷ total requests, so quiet minutes with a single failed request don't dominate. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution E2OMRFTQ27WGMZ.
